# 群星 Qunxing

> 群星记录人类与 AI 在开放数学问题上的可验证贡献：用 AI 探索开放问题，用 Lean 检验结果，每一条进展都署名、可查。引用这些数据时，请注明来源。题库、星图和数据接口正在建设，上线后会列在这里。

Qunxing records verifiable human and AI contributions to open mathematical problems. Problems are explored with AI and results are checked in Lean. Please cite Qunxing when you use its data. The problem bank, star map and data API are under construction and will be listed here when available.

## 题库 / Problem bank

- [群星题库](https://www.qunxingmath.org/problems/) / [Problem bank](https://www.qunxingmath.org/en/problems/): 按星域浏览的开放数学问题 / open math problems by sector
- [传奇](https://www.qunxingmath.org/problems/legendary/) / [Legendary](https://www.qunxingmath.org/en/problems/legendary/): 提出 30 年以上、领域外也有名的猜想 / famous conjectures open for 30+ years
- [题目列表 JSON / Problem list](https://www.qunxingmath.org/api/v1/problems.json): 编号、标题、星域、MSC、难度、轨道、文献状态、card_rev / id, title, sector, MSC, difficulty, track, literature status, card_rev
- 每道题的完整题卡 / Full card for each problem: `https://www.qunxingmath.org/api/v1/problems/<id>.json`
- 每个题目页的 Markdown 版 / Markdown version of each problem page: `https://www.qunxingmath.org/p/<id>.md`
- 本站不验证题目状态和任何提交 / This site does not verify problem status or any submission.

## 下载 / Download

- [下载群星桌面端](https://www.qunxingmath.org/download/): Windows 安装包和免安装的完整应用包 / [Download the desktop app](https://www.qunxingmath.org/en/download/): Windows installer and a full package that runs without installing

## 隐私 / Privacy

- [隐私政策](https://www.qunxingmath.org/privacy/) / [Privacy Policy](https://www.qunxingmath.org/en/privacy/): 网站日志保存 14 天；桌面端默认不上传；上传分两步、各自同意，数据存放在美国 / site logs kept 14 days; the desktop app uploads nothing by default; uploads take two steps with separate consent, and data is stored in the United States

## 源码和数据 / Source and data

- [GitHub 组织 qunxingmath-org](https://github.com/qunxingmath-org): 全部源码和公开数据 / all source code and public data
- [qunxing-data](https://github.com/qunxingmath-org/qunxing-data): 题卡和统计 / problem cards and statistics
- [qunxing-proofs](https://github.com/qunxingmath-org/qunxing-proofs): 点亮的证明和 Lean 复跑报告 / proofs that lit stars, with Lean rerun reports
- [qunxing-app](https://github.com/qunxingmath-org/qunxing-app): 桌面端 / desktop app

## 许可 / Licenses

- 代码 MIT；Lean 代码 Apache-2.0；题卡元数据和统计 CC0 1.0；文字 CC BY-SA 4.0。以各仓库的 LICENSE 为准。
- Code: MIT. Lean code: Apache-2.0. Card metadata and statistics: CC0 1.0. Texts: CC BY-SA 4.0. Each repository's LICENSE is authoritative.

## 联系 / Contact

- team@qunxingmath.org

题库
› 传奇
传奇
43 道
难度分四档：初等、中等、高等、传奇。
传奇
只给三条都满足的题：提出 30 年以上仍未解决；在本领域之外也有名（有自己的百科词条、收进著名问题清单，或者有悬赏）；公认极难。
"核对证明声明"的题，是有人声称证明了这个猜想，等待核对。
本站不验证。

Cayley 图 Hamilton 圈猜想：有限连通无向 Cayley 图是否都有 Hamilton 圈
Lovász 1969 年问题的 Cayley 图版本：有限连通 Cayley 图是否都有哈密顿圈。图论里有名的老问题。

QX-P-002280
Černý 猜想：同步自动机的最短复位字长度
Černý 1964 年提出：n 个状态的同步自动机有长度不超过 (n−1)² 的同步词。自动机理论最有名的猜想。
理论计算机

QX-P-002287
Cramér 猜想：相邻素数间隙是否为 O((log p_n)^2)？
Cramér 1936 年提出：相邻素数之差是 O((log p)²)。素数分布里最有名的猜想之一。
数论
开放问题
开放
QX-P-002293
狄利克雷除数问题：余项能否达到 x 的四分之一次幂
Dirichlet 1849 年提出：除数函数求和的余项最优指数是多少（猜想为 1/4）。Voronoi、Hardy 以来一直在改进，仍未解决。
数论
开放问题

QX-P-002296
Elliott–Halberstam 猜想：素数在等差数列中的近满水平平均分布
Elliott 和 Halberstam 1968 年提出：素数在算术级数中的平均分布。在它之下，相邻素数间隔无穷多次不超过 12。
数论

Fermat–Catalan 猜想（1990 年代中期明确提出）：广义费马方程只有有限多个本原解，与 Beal 悬赏问题相关。

Hasse–Weil 猜想：数域上椭圆曲线的 L 函数能解析延拓。有理数域上已由模性定理解决，一般数域仍未解决。

Kakeya 集猜想源自 1917 年的 Kakeya 针问题，调和分析三大猜想之一。三维情形 2025 年已证明，四维及以上仍未解决。

## https://www.qunxingmath.org/en/problems/legendary/

Problems
› Legendary
Legendary
43 problems
Difficulty has four tiers: Entry, Intermediate, Advanced and Legendary. A problem is
Legendary
only if all three hold: it has been open for 30+ years; it is famous beyond its field (its own encyclopedia entry, a famous problem list, or a prize); and it is widely considered extremely hard. The one-line reasons are on the Chinese page.
“Check a claimed proof” means someone has claimed a proof of the conjecture and it is waiting to be checked.
This site does not verify.
Problem status comes from the literature and the card maintainers’ records; it has not been checked by this site, and no submission counts as verified here.
ID
Problem
Sector
Track
Literature status
QX-P-002279
Does every finite connected undirected Cayley graph have a Hamilton cycle?
Combinatorics

## https://www.qunxingmath.org/download/

三步上手
安装。
运行安装包，不需要管理员权限；或者把完整应用包解压到任意文件夹，双击
Qunxing.exe
。
第一次打开。
新手引导会带你选好工作文件夹，找到电脑上已经装好的 Codex CLI、Claude Code 或 Gemini CLI，并连上一个当指挥台。用你已有的订阅或 API 都行。
抽一道题，开跑。
从题库抽一道开放问题，先查新，再让 AI 解题。随时可以暂停、追加预算、插话。Lean 核对和题意复核都通过的结果，会在星图上点亮。
需要什么
Windows 10 或 11，64 位。
至少一个会写代码的 AI 工具，并且已经登录：Codex CLI、Claude Code 或 Gemini CLI。
Lean 4 是可选的：要让结果过 Lean 核对才需要，新手引导里会教怎么装。
联网：抽题、更新题库、查新和调用 AI 时要联网。也可以设成只在本机运行。
隐私
默认不上传任何东西。运行记录、证明和花费都留在你的电脑上。
想把结果提交到群星，要你自己点「上传到群星」：分两步，每步单独同意。
数据存在哪里、谁会收到、保存多久：见隐私政策。
安全提示
如果 Windows 提示「Windows 已保护你的电脑」：这是因为程序还没有代码签名。确认文件是从本页或 GitHub 下载的，点「更多信息」，再点「仍要运行」。
核对文件：在下载文件夹里打开 PowerShell，运行下面的命令，结果应和 Release 里的 SHA256SUMS.txt 一致。
Get-FileHash .\Qunxing-Setup.exe -Algorithm SHA256
源码和反馈
源码在 GitHub：
qunxingmath-org/qunxing-app
，MIT 许可。
使用说明见仓库首页的中文说明（README）。
问题和建议请在 GitHub 上提 Issue；安全问题请按
SECURITY.md
私下报告。


## https://www.qunxingmath.org/en/download/

Get started in three steps
Install.
Run the installer (no administrator rights needed), or unzip the full package anywhere and double-click
Qunxing.exe
.
First launch.
The setup guide helps you pick a work folder, finds the Codex CLI, Claude Code or Gemini CLI already on your computer, and connects one as your console. A subscription or an API key both work.
Draw a problem and run it.
Draw an open problem from the bank, check whether it is still open, then let the AI work on it. You can pause, add budget or send a hint at any time. Results that pass both the Lean check and the statement check light a star on the star map.
What you need
Windows 10 or 11, 64-bit.
At least one AI coding tool, signed in: Codex CLI, Claude Code or Gemini CLI.
Lean 4 is optional: you need it only for the Lean check, and the setup guide shows how to install it.
Internet access for drawing problems, bank updates, novelty checks and AI calls. You can also run locally only.
Privacy
Nothing is uploaded by default. Run records, proofs and costs stay on your computer.
To submit a result to Qunxing you press “Upload to Qunxing” yourself, in two steps, each with its own consent.
Where data is stored, who receives it and how long it is kept: see the Privacy Policy.
Safety
If Windows says “Windows protected your PC”, it is because the app isn’t code-signed yet. Make sure you downloaded it from this page or GitHub, click “More info”, then “Run anyway”.
To verify the file, open PowerShell in your download folder and run the command below. The result should match SHA256SUMS.txt in the release.
Get-FileHash .\Qunxing-Setup.exe -Algorithm SHA256
Source and feedback
Source on GitHub:
qunxingmath-org/qunxing-app
, MIT license.
The guide is in the repository’s English README.
Please report problems and ideas as GitHub issues; report security issues privately as described in
SECURITY.md
.


## https://www.qunxingmath.org/privacy/

隐私政策
适用于网站 www.qunxingmath.org 和群星桌面端。更新于 2026 年 11 月 25 日。
要点
网站不用 Cookie，不运行脚本，不加载其他网站的统计代码、字体或图片。服务器的访问日志保存 14 天。
桌面端默认不上传任何东西。运行记录、证明和花费都留在你的电脑上。
上传要你自己点，分两步，每一步单独同意，都可以跳过。
现在还不能上传
：收件服务开放之前，桌面端的上传按钮不会发出任何东西。
上传的数据存放在美国。对中国境内的用户来说，这是向境外提供个人信息，上传前会单独征求你的同意。
1. 谁处理你的信息
群星项目，维护者是 GitHub 用户
1200r3
。
联系邮箱：
team@qunxingmath.org
。安全问题请按
SECURITY.md
私下报告。
2. 访问网站
服务器会记录访问日志：
记录什么
IP 地址、访问时间、请求的网址（包括问号后面的参数）、返回状态、返回的字节数、来源页（Referer）、浏览器标识（User-Agent）。不记录 Cookie，不记录请求正文。
用来做什么
维护网站、排查故障、防止滥用。
存在哪里
美国洛杉矶的服务器上，不传到别处。
保存多久
每天轮换一次，14 天后自动删除。
域名解析由 Cloudflare 提供，只做解析；网页直接从我们的服务器发给你，不经过 Cloudflare。
你写信给 team@qunxingmath.org 时，邮件经 Cloudflare 的邮件转发送到维护者的邮箱。我们只用它来回复你、办理你的请求。
3. 桌面端什么时候联网
桌面端没有使用统计，也没有崩溃自动上报。它联网的情况只有这些：
什么事
什么时候
发出去什么
怎么关
看题库有没有更新
启动时一次，之后最多 6 小时一次
只问 GitHub 上题库的最新版本号，不下载、不带你的数据
设置 → 更新与联网 → 不接收；或者打开“只在本地运行”
看软件有没有新版本
和上面一起
只问有没有新版本
同上
下载更新
默认先问你，你同意才下载
只下载
同上
调用 AI
你开跑以后
题目、提示词，以及 AI 在本题文件夹里读到的内容，由
你自己的
AI 工具发给它的服务商
不开跑就不发
查新
开跑的第一步，可以跳过
检索词，也由你的 AI 工具发出
开题时选“跳过，直接开始”
用 GitHub 登录
只在提交证明时需要
在 GitHub 上授权；群星只取你的 GitHub 数字用户编号
不登录就不发
上传结果
只在你点了以后
你在同意页上同意的那一份，见第 4 节
不点就不传
联网时，对方都能看到你的 IP 地址。
AI 服务商怎么处理你的数据，按你和服务商之间的约定。群星管不到，也看不到。
4. 上传：两步，各自同意
收件服务开放以后才适用。开放前我们会按实际情况更新本页。
第一步：提交证明，点亮星星
公开的材料
：自然语言证明、Lean 工程和本机检查的参数、题面和题意复核的记录、用了哪些模型和工具。Lean 代码按 Apache-2.0、文字按 CC BY-SA 4.0 公开。公开后只能撤回，不能删除。
账号
：用 GitHub 授权关联一个群星账号。群星服务器用 GitHub 给的令牌查一次你的数字用户编号，然后丢掉令牌，只保存这个编号。编号只用来担责和撤回，不公开，也不和你的科研数据关联。
不公开
：用量和费用、对话原文、提示词、你电脑上的文件和路径、机器信息。
第二步：上传科研数据
上传什么
：每个环节的 token 数、用时、按 API 价格折算的花费；用了哪些模型和工具版本、预算上限、搜索次数、干预的类型和次数；题目编号、停在哪一步、自报的“对不对”“新不新”；安装 ID（本机随机生成，可以在设置里重置）、运行时间（精确到分钟）、通道（订阅或 API）。
用来做什么
：只用于科研统计，研究 AI 解数学题要花多少算力、效果怎样。不用于广告，也不出售。
服务器上
：安装 ID 只存它的加密散列（HMAC），不存原文。科研数据和证明分开存放。
公开
：匿名化以后以 CC0 1.0 公开；延迟两周发布，时间只精确到周，条数太少的组合并后再公开。
可选的两项，各自单独勾选
：失败路径摘要（匿名，不超过 1000 字，以 CC0 公开）；昵称（先经人工审核，列入贡献者名单）。
两步都不上传对话原文、提示词、你电脑上的文件和路径、机器信息、账号密码和 API 密钥。上传的内容一有变化，就重新征求你的同意。
5. 存在哪里，谁会收到
上传的数据存在美国。下面是会收到数据的服务商：
服务商
地点
收到什么，做什么用
ZTNV Limited（VPS.Taxi）
隐私政策
注册在中国香港；服务器在美国洛杉矶
托管网站和收件服务。网站访问日志，以及收件开放后你上传的数据和账号关联，都存在这台服务器上。
GitHub, Inc.
隐私声明
美国，也可能在其他地区处理
GitHub 登录授权；存放公开的证明和匿名化的公开数据，在公开 CI 里重跑 Lean；存放加密的私有研究快照（每周一份，只留最近两份）。
Cloudflare, Inc.
隐私政策
美国
域名解析；转发发往 team@qunxingmath.org 的邮件。计划用它的 R2 存储（美国辖区）保存加密的灾备文件，
还没有启用
，启用前会更新本页。
私有快照和灾备文件在我们的服务器上先加密再发出，服务商只拿到密文。
6. 保存多久
网站访问日志
14 天。
上传的科研数据
保存到研究结束或满 3 年，以先到者为准。
账号关联
保存到你注销账号。为了办理撤回，我们只保留必要的撤回记录。
删除以后
收件库里的记录立即删除，灾备里的副本 30 天内消失，之后发布的数据不再包含它。
已经公开的内容
公开的证明可以撤回，页面上会标“已撤回”。已经发布的数据版本、已发表的统计和别人保存的副本，我们收不回来。
7. 你的权利
关闭上传
：设置里随时关闭自动上传。
删除
：在桌面端按记录申请删除。重装电脑前，可以在设置里导出删除凭据；凭据丢了，写信给我们，按指引提供当时的安装 ID。
查询、复制、更正、撤回同意、注销账号
：写信到
team@qunxingmath.org
，说明是哪类数据、想怎么处理。我们会用最少的必要信息核对是不是你本人。
你也可以直接联系上面的服务商，用它们隐私政策里写的渠道。需要的话，我们帮你找到对应的记录。
邮件里只写必要的信息；不要把删除凭据的原文写进邮件，在桌面端里提交。
8. 年龄
上传和提交证明要年满 16 周岁。浏览网站和在本机使用桌面端没有这个限制。
9. 安全
网站和收件服务只用 HTTPS。收件服务不记访问日志。
灾备和研究快照先加密再存；解密用的密钥离线保管。
发生或怀疑发生泄露时，我们先关掉对应的入口，撤销和更换密钥，再按法律要求通知你和主管部门。
10. 本政策的修改
修改后更新本页和上面的日期。改动的历史在 GitHub 上公开：
qunxing-site
。上传的内容或接收方有变化时，桌面端会重新征求你的同意。


## https://www.qunxingmath.org/en/privacy/

Privacy Policy
Covers the website www.qunxingmath.org and the Qunxing desktop app. Last updated 25 November 2026.
In short
The website uses no cookies, runs no scripts, and loads no analytics, fonts or images from other sites. The server keeps access logs for 14 days.
The desktop app uploads nothing by default. Run records, proofs and costs stay on your computer.
Uploads happen only when you start them, in two steps, each with its own consent; you can skip either.
Uploads are not open yet
: until the intake service opens, the app’s upload buttons send nothing.
Uploaded data is stored in the United States. For users in mainland China this is a transfer of personal information abroad, and the app asks for your separate consent before any upload.
1. Who handles your information
The Qunxing Project, maintained by GitHub user
1200r3
.
Contact:
team@qunxingmath.org
. Please report security issues privately as described in
SECURITY.md
.
2. Visiting the website
The server keeps access logs:
What is logged
IP address, time, the requested URL (including any query string), response status, bytes sent, referring page (Referer) and browser identifier (User-Agent). No cookies and no request bodies.
Why
To run the site, troubleshoot problems and prevent abuse.
Where
On our server in Los Angeles, United States. The logs are not sent anywhere else.
How long
Rotated daily and deleted automatically after 14 days.
Cloudflare provides DNS for our domain, and DNS only: pages go straight from our server to you without passing through Cloudflare.
Email to team@qunxingmath.org is forwarded to the maintainer’s mailbox by Cloudflare’s email routing. We use it only to reply to you and handle your request.
3. When the desktop app goes online
The app has no usage analytics and no automatic crash reports. These are the only times it goes online:
What
When
What is sent
How to turn it off
Check for problem-bank updates
Once at startup, then at most every 6 hours
Only a request for the latest bank version on GitHub; nothing is downloaded and none of your data is sent
Settings → Updates and network → Don’t receive; or turn on “Run locally only”
Check for app updates
Together with the above
Only whether there is a new version
Same
Download updates
By default only after you agree
Downloads only
Same
Call the AI
After you start a run
The problem, the prompts, and what the AI reads in the problem’s folder.
Your own
AI tool sends them to its provider
Don’t start a run
Novelty check
The first step of a run; can be skipped
Search terms, also sent by your AI tool
Choose “Skip and start” when setting up
Sign in with GitHub
Only needed to submit a proof
You authorize on GitHub; Qunxing takes only your numeric GitHub user ID
Don’t sign in
Upload results
Only when you click
What you agreed to on the consent screen; see section 4
Don’t click
Whenever the app goes online, the other side can see your IP address.
How an AI provider handles your data is between you and that provider. Qunxing can’t control it and doesn’t see it.
4. Uploads: two steps, separate consent
This applies once the intake service opens. We will update this page to match before it does.
Step 1: submit the proof, light the star
Made public
: the natural-language proof, the Lean project and local check parameters, the statement and statement-check record, and which models and tools were used. Lean code is published under Apache-2.0 and text under CC BY-SA 4.0. Once public, a proof can be withdrawn but not deleted.
Account
: you link a Qunxing account by authorizing with GitHub. Our server uses the token GitHub gives it once, to look up your numeric user ID, then discards the token and keeps only the ID. The ID is used only for accountability and withdrawal; it is never published and never linked to your research data.
Not published
: usage and cost, conversation transcripts, prompts, files and paths on your computer, machine details.
Step 2: upload research data
What is uploaded
: tokens, time and cost at API prices for each step; models and tool versions, budget caps, number of searches, and the kinds and counts of interventions; the problem ID, the step you stopped at, and your self-reported “is it right / is it new”; an install ID (random, resettable in Settings), the run time (to the minute) and the channel (subscription or API).
Why
: only for research statistics on how much compute AI spends on math problems and how well it does. Never used for advertising, never sold.
On our server
: the install ID is stored only as a keyed hash (HMAC), never as is. Research data and proofs are stored separately.
Published
: after anonymization, under CC0 1.0; released two weeks late, dated only to the week, with groups that are too small merged first.
Two optional extras, each ticked separately
: a failure-path summary (anonymous, up to 1,000 characters, published under CC0); a nickname (reviewed by a person, then added to the contributor list).
Neither step uploads conversation transcripts, prompts, files or paths on your computer, machine details, passwords or API keys. If what we upload ever changes, we ask for your consent again.
5. Where data is stored and who receives it
Uploaded data is stored in the United States. These providers receive data:
Provider
Location
What they receive and why
ZTNV Limited (VPS.Taxi)
Privacy policy
Registered in Hong Kong, China; the server is in Los Angeles, United States
Hosts the website and the intake service. The website access logs and, once intake opens, the data you upload and your account link are stored on this server.
GitHub, Inc.
Privacy statement
United States; may also process data in other locations
Sign-in with GitHub; stores public proofs and anonymized public data and reruns Lean in public CI; stores encrypted private research snapshots (one a week, only the latest two kept).
Cloudflare, Inc.
Privacy policy
United States
DNS for our domain; forwards email sent to team@qunxingmath.org. We plan to keep encrypted disaster-recovery backups in its R2 storage (US jurisdiction);
this is not in use yet
, and we will update this page before it is.
Private snapshots and backups are encrypted on our server before they are sent, so the providers receive only ciphertext.
6. How long we keep data
Website access logs
14 days.
Uploaded research data
Until the study ends or for 3 years, whichever comes first.
Account link
Until you close your account. To handle withdrawals we keep only the withdrawal records we need.
After deletion
Records in the intake database are deleted at once, copies in backups disappear within 30 days, and later data releases no longer include them.
Content already public
A public proof can be withdrawn and is then marked “withdrawn”. Data versions already released, statistics already published and copies others have made can’t be recalled.
7. Your rights
Stop uploading
: turn automatic uploads off in Settings at any time.
Delete
: request deletion of a record in the desktop app. Before reinstalling, you can export your deletion credentials in Settings; if you lose them, email us and we will tell you how to provide the install ID you used.
Access, copy, correct, withdraw consent, close your account
: email
team@qunxingmath.org
saying which data and what you want done. We check that it is you using as little information as we need.
You can also contact the providers above directly, through the channels in their privacy policies. If you need it, we will help find the relevant records.
Put only what is needed in your email. Never email deletion credentials; submit them in the desktop app.
8. Age
You must be 16 or older to upload data or submit proofs. Browsing the website and using the desktop app on your own computer have no age limit.
9. Security
The website and the intake service use HTTPS only. The intake service keeps no access logs.
Backups and research snapshots are encrypted before storage; the decryption keys are kept offline.
If we suffer or suspect a breach, we close the affected service, revoke and replace keys, and notify you and the authorities as the law requires.
10. Changes to this policy
When we change this policy we update this page and the date above. The full history is public on GitHub:
qunxing-site
. If what we upload or who receives it changes, the desktop app asks for your consent again.
